lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੀ ਚਖਉ ਸਾਡੜੇ ਕਿਤੀ ਵੇਸ ਕਰੇਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kitee chakhau saadaRe kitee ves kareu ||
lines.translation: I have tasted many flavors, and worn many robes,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਗਇਅਮੁ ਵਾਢੀ ਝੂਰੇਦੀ ਝੂਰੇਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: pir bin joban baad gaiam vaadhee jhooredee jhooreu ||5||
lines.translation: but without my Husband Lord, my youth is slipping away uselessly; I am separated from Him, and I cry out in pain. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੰਦਾ ਸਦੜਾ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache sa(n)daa sadaRaa suneeai gur veechaar ||
lines.translation: I have heard the True Lord's message, contemplating the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sache sachaa baihanaa nadaree nadar piaar ||6||
lines.translation: True is the home of the True Lord; by His Gracious Grace, I love Him. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਾ ਡੇਖੈ ਡੇਖਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaanee a(n)jan sach kaa dekhai dekhanahaar ||
lines.translation: The spiritual teacher applies the ointment of Truth to his eyes, and sees God, the Seer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh boojhai jaaneeai haumai garab nivaar ||7||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh comes to know and understand; ego and pride are subdued. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਤਉ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਮੂ ਜੇਹੀਆ ਕਿਤੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau bhaavan tau jeheeaa moo jeheeaa kiteeaah ||
lines.translation: O Lord, You are pleased with those who are like Yourself; there are many more like me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੈ ਰਤੜੀਆਹ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naahu na veechhuRai tin sachai rataReeaah ||8||1||9||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Husband does not separate from those who are imbued with Truth. ||8||1||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਭੈਣਾ ਭਰਜਾਈਆ ਨਾ ਸੇ ਸਸੁੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa bhainaa bharajaaeeaa naa se sasuReeaah ||
lines.translation: Neither the sisters, nor the sisters-in-law, nor the mothers-in-law, shall remain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਕੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਹੀਆਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa saak na tutaee gur mele saheeaah ||1||
lines.translation: The true relationship with the Lord cannot be broken; it was established by the Lord, O sister soul-brides. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane sad balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਏਤਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਲਿਮੁ ਦਿਤਮੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin etaa bhav thakee gur pir melim ditam milaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Wandering so far without the Guru, I grew weary; now, the Guru has united me in Union with my Husband Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੁਫੀ ਨਾਨੀ ਮਾਸੀਆ ਦੇਰ ਜੇਠਾਨੜੀਆਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: phuphee naanee maaseeaa der jethaanaReeaah ||
lines.translation: Aunts, uncles, grandparents and sisters-in-law

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਨਿ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਨਾ ਰਹਨਿ ਪੂਰ ਭਰੇ ਪਹੀਆਹ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aavan va(n)njan naa rahan poor bhare paheeaah ||2||
lines.translation: - they all come and go; they cannot remain. They are like boatloads of passengers embarking. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਮੇ ਤੈ ਮਾਮਾਣੀਆ ਭਾਇਰ ਬਾਪ ਨ ਮਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maame tai maamaaneeaa bhaair baap na maau ||
lines.translation: Uncles, aunts, and cousins of all sorts, cannot remain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਥ ਲਡੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਠੀਆ ਭੀੜ ਘਣੀ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saath lade tin naatheeaa bheeR ghanee dareeaau ||3||
lines.translation: The caravans are full, and great crowds of them are loading up at the riverbank. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੋ ਸਖੀ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachau ra(n)g ra(n)gaavalo sakhee hamaaro ka(n)t ||
lines.translation: O sister-friends, my Husband Lord is dyed in the color of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sach vichhoRaa naa theeai so sahu ra(n)g rava(n)t ||4||
lines.translation: She who lovingly remembers her True Husband Lord is not separated from Him again. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਰੁਤੀ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe rutee cha(n)geeaa jit sache siu nehu ||
lines.translation: All the seasons are good, in which the soul-bride falls in love with the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਨਿਸਿ ਡੇਹੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan ka(n)t pachhaaniaa sukh sutee nis dehu ||5||
lines.translation: That soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord, sleeps in peace, night and day. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਣਿ ਕੂਕੇ ਪਾਤਣੀ ਵੰਞਹੁ ਧ੍ਰੁਕਿ ਵਿਲਾੜਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: patan kooke paatanee va(n)njahu dhruk vilaaR ||
lines.translation: At the ferry, the ferryman announces, "O travellers, hurry up and cross over."

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਿ ਪਵੰਦੜੇ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥਿ ਚਾੜਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: paar pava(n)daRe dith mai satigur bohith chaaR ||6||
lines.translation: I have seen them crossing over there, on the boat of the True Guru. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਕਨੀ ਲਦਿਆ ਹਿਕਿ ਲਦਿ ਗਏ ਹਿਕਿ ਭਾਰੇ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hikanee ladiaa hik lad gae hik bhaare bhar naal ||
lines.translation: Some are getting on board, and some have already set out; some are weighed down with their loads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa se sache prabh naal ||7||
lines.translation: Those who deal in Truth, remain with their True Lord God. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਮ ਚੰਗੇ ਆਖੀਅਹ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਦਿਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ham cha(n)ge aakheeah buraa na disai koi ||
lines.translation: I am not called good, and I see none who are bad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਜੇਹੜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak haumai maareeai sache jehaRaa soi ||8||2||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who conquers and subdues his ego, becomes just like the True Lord. ||8||2||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa jaanaa moorakh hai koee naa jaanaa siaanaa ||
lines.translation: I do not believe that anyone is foolish; I do not believe that anyone is clever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa saahib kai ra(n)ge raataa anadin naam vakhaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: Imbued forever with the Love of my Lord and Master, I chant His Name, night and day. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹਾ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa moorakh haa naavai bal jaau ||
lines.translation: O Baba, I am so foolish, but I am a sacrifice to the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too karataa too daanaa beenaa terai naam taraau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are the Creator, You are wise and all-seeing. Through Your Name, we are carried across. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh siaanaa ek hai ek jot dui naau ||
lines.translation: The same person is foolish and wise; the same light within has two names.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: moorakhaa sir moorakh hai j ma(n)ne naahee naau ||2||
lines.translation: The most foolish of the foolish are those who do not believe in the Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur duaarai naau paaeeai bin satigur palai na paai ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Gate, the Gurdwara, the Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, it is not received.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai man vasai taa ahinis rahai liv laai ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Pleasure of the True Guru's Will, the Name comes to dwell in the mind, and then, night and day, one remains lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੰ ਰੰਗੰ ਰੂਪੰ ਮਾਲੰ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇ ਜੂਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaja(n) ra(n)ga(n) roopa(n) maala(n) joban te jooaaree ||
lines.translation: In power, pleasures, beauty, wealth and youth, one gambles his life away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਾਧੇ ਪਾਸੈ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਏਕਾ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: hukamee baadhe paasai khelahi chaupaR ekaa saaree ||4||
lines.translation: Bound by the Hukam of God's Command, the dice are thrown; he is just a piece in the game of chess. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ ਨਾਉ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag chatur siaanaa bharam bhulaanaa naau pa(n)dit paRahi gaavaaree ||
lines.translation: The world is clever and wise, but it is deluded by doubt, and forgets the Name; the Pandit, the religious scholar, studies the scriptures, but he is still a fool.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲੇ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naau visaarahi bed samaalahi bikh bhoole lekhaaree ||5||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Name, he dwells upon the Vedas; he writes, but he is confused by his poisonous corruption. ||5||
